verdict.rationale: Reader does have a hosted proxy option (`x-proxy: auto`), but it is documented as rotating residential and datacenter IPs. Nothing in the evidence shows a session identifier that pins multiple requests to the same IP. The `X-Set-Cookie` header forwards cookies, which is an adjacent feature and does not keep the IP identity consistent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity
